_comment: Maintained advisory inventory for native libraries bundled inside Python wheels. Deliberately small: only advisories confirmed from public records, each with a source link. Each entry flags any bundled version numerically below affected_below (one threshold per entry, so a fix backported to an older branch is not modelled). Before adding a component, check that its file-name version is a release: some libraries name only an ABI (libpq-*.so.5.16, libssl-*.so.1.1), which would misattribute. Entries for libpq and libxmlsec1 were removed at review because their ids and fixed versions could not be confirmed.

libxml2.summary: use-after-free of ID and IDREF attributes
dict corruption caused by entity reference cycles

libxslt.summary: use-after-free (reported via Blink XSLT), fixed in libxslt 1.1.35
